concepts.title: 1. Mapping Contexts to APs
concepts.subtitle: Define a, d, and n
concepts.summary: Map the starting quantity to a, the constant change to d, and the periods or positions to n.
concepts.trap: Confusing the starting amount with the change.

concepts.title: 2. Specific Term vs Total Sum
concepts.subtitle: Choose a_n or S_n
concepts.summary: Use a_n for one position and S_n for a cumulative quantity across positions.
concepts.trap: Using a_n when the question asks for a total.

concepts.title: 3. Physical and Structural Arrangements
concepts.subtitle: Rows, rungs, levels, logs, and seats
concepts.summary: Constant changes in rows, rungs, layers, or levels form APs; sum the row counts for a whole-structure total.

points.text: Use S_n for the whole arrangement.

concepts.trap: Reporting the last row instead of total capacity.

concepts.title: 4. Production Targets and Annual Increments
concepts.subtitle: Model output year by year
concepts.summary: Annual production targets with a constant increment or decrement form an AP. Use a_n for one year's target and S_n for cumulative production.
concepts.trap: Treating annual output as if it were cumulative output.

concepts.title: 5. CBSE Case-Study Modeling
concepts.subtitle: Separate the requested quantities
concepts.summary: Map the repeated pattern to an AP, calculate each requested term or sum, then apply the stated budget, capacity, or allocation constraint.
concepts.trap: Applying a limit to one period instead of the cumulative amount.
